current_opening: A tempestuous noise of thunder and lightning heard. Enter a Ship-Master and a Boatswain. Master: Boatswain! Boatswain: Here, master: what cheer? Master: Good, speak to the mariners: fall to't, yarely, or we run ourselves aground: bestir, bestir. Exit. Enter Mariners. Boatswain: Heigh, my hearts! cheerly, cheerly, my hearts! yare, yare! Take in the topsail. Tend to the master's whistle.
proposed_openingText: [A storm. Thunder and lightning. Enter the Master and the Boatswain.] MASTER. Boatswain! BOATSWAIN. Here, captain. What's happening? MASTER. Good man, get the sailors moving. Hurry up, quickly, or we'll run aground. Move it, move it! [Exit] [Enter Mariners] BOATSWAIN. Come on, lads! Cheerfully now, cheerfully! Quickly, quickly! Take in the topsail. Listen for the captain's whistle. Blow, storm, blow until you burst, as long as we have room to maneuver!
